specs.title: Slug and public tenant page
specs.why: This is the merchant's shareable shopfront and the entry point for every public booking.
specs.scope: SSR route at `/{slug}` rendering a branded landing page with services, hours and a booking CTA.
tasks: Add `app/[slug]/page.tsx`: return `notFound()` for missing or inactive tenants
Add `app/[slug]/head.tsx`: add SEO and Open Graph tags
acceptance: A valid slug responds with HTTP 200 under 500ms TTFB
Lighthouse SEO score is 95 or above

specs.title: Availability engine
specs.why: Slot computation is the highest-risk logic in the product and benefits from being pure and exhaustively tested.
specs.scope: Pure function returning open slots from service, date range, existing bookings, hours, buffers, lead time and max advance.
tasks: Add `lib/availability.ts`: handle duration, buffer, lead time and max-advance
Add `tests/availability.test.ts`: add fixtures and edge cases
acceptance: Branch coverage of `lib/availability.ts` is 95% or above, verified by `pnpm test`
Every fixture in `tests/availability.test.ts` returns the expected slots
